name: NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500
description: New York Department of Financial Services Cybersecurity Requirements for Financial Services Companies. Establishes cybersecurity requirements for banks, insurance companies, and other financial services institutions regulated by DFS.

name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: International standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Provides a systematic approach to managing sensitive company information through risk management processes.

name: SOC 2 Type II
description: Service Organization Control 2 Type II report based on Trust Services Criteria. Evaluates security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy controls over a period of time.

name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
description: Framework for improving critical infrastructure cybersecurity. Provides a common taxonomy and mechanism for organizations to describe their current cybersecurity posture and target state.

name: PCI DSS 4.0
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard. Security standard for organizations that handle branded credit cards to increase controls around cardholder data and reduce credit card fraud.

name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
description: Framework to better manage risks to individuals, organizations, and society associated with artificial intelligence. Addresses AI risks and promotes trustworthy AI development and use.

name: GLBA Safeguards Rule
description: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act Safeguards Rule requires financial institutions to develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive security program to protect customer information.
